checkedFindings.text: The first parliament opened to discuss a newly written constitution.
checkedFindings.caveat: This is not automatically the constitution promulgation date or a new country founding.

checkedFindings.text: Charles St Julian sent the Hawaiian Constitution of1852 to George Tupou I; the parliamentary history identifies it as an influence on the Tongan constitution.
checkedFindings.navigation: Potential Hawaii-to-Tonga knowledge link; avoid asserting identical political institutions.

checkedFindings.text: The original parliament combined ministers, nobles and elected people representatives. It exercised legislative and fiscal powers.
The capitals submission attributes a roughly950 origin to subsequently recorded oral tradition. It does not establish an exact founding year.

requiredPhases: Early Tu'i Tonga chiefly authority and archaeologically dated Lapaha expansion.
Tu'i Ha'atakalaua and Tu'i Kanokupolu executive lines, retaining the distinct sacred chiefly line.
George Tupou I unification and constitutional-government phase.
Protected-state treaty relationship and later foreign-affairs transition, without describing Tonga as culturally extinct or assuming a conquered colony.
